aggregate_test.otherwise: retain prevalence-only explanation as sufficient at the declared resolution; do not retune null or thresholds
aggregate_test.test: one-sided exact sign test of site effects > 0 against probability 0.5

positive_if_all: status does not contain no capture
taxonID belongs to frozen target set

count_conditioned_null.randomization: sample k nodes uniformly without replacement from the frozen guild-positive node set
count_conditioned_null.species_carrier_excess: observed carrier indicator - expected carrier probability
count_conditioned_null.species_expected_carrier_probability: fraction of count-conditioned random placements satisfying every site adjacency criterion

additive_decomposition.between_grid_allocation_component: grid-conditioned expected carrier probability - site-wide count-conditioned expected carrier probability
additive_decomposition.site_summary: mean each component across eligible species; report the exact reconstruction error, which must be numerically zero apart from floating-point tolerance
additive_decomposition.within_grid_organization_component: observed carrier indicator - grid-conditioned expected carrier probability

secondary_grid_conditioned_null.causal_boundary: grid identity is a spatial stratum and potential habitat proxy, not a measured habitat variable; a habitat mechanism would require independently measured environmental covariates
conditioning: species observed positive-node count separately within each grid
secondary_grid_conditioned_null.grid_id_rule: for each frozen trap node, grid_id is the node label with the final '.<trapCoordinate>' segment removed

interpretation.both_sitewide_and_grid_conditioned_posit: within-grid spatial organization contributes beyond prevalence and observed grid allocation
interpretation.primary_sitewide_near_zero: occupied-node prevalence is sufficient at the declared site-wide scale; do not use the grid-conditioned result to rescue the primary
interpretation.primary_sitewide_positive_but_grid_condi: the extra continuity is largely attributable to between-grid allocation, consistent with coarse habitat/grid filtering rather than within-grid clustering

secondary_grid_conditioned_null.randomization: within each grid used by the species, sample the observed number of positive nodes uniformly without replacement from guild-positive nodes in that same grid; union sampled nodes across grids
secondary_grid_conditioned_null.species_grid_conditioned_carrier_excess: observed carrier indicator - expected carrier probability under the grid-conditioned null
secondary_grid_conditioned_null.status: predeclared mechanistic decomposition; cannot rescue or alter primary site-wide count-conditioned result

analysis_rule.across_site_summary: median of estimable within-site Spearman rho values and counts of positive/zero/negative site rhos
analysis_rule.inference: descriptive secondary only; no trait p-value can rescue or alter the primary count-conditioned result
analysis_rule.join_rule: exact scientific-name match to the response-blind frozen COMBINE target-pool table; no post-response synonym rescue
analysis_rule.missing_data: complete cases per trait within site; no imputation beyond values already frozen in the COMBINE table before response
analysis_rule.outcome: species_carrier_excess after conditioning on observed positive-node count
analysis_rule.within_site_statistic: Spearman rho between trait and species_carrier_excess when >=3 matched eligible species have nonmissing trait values and both variables vary

secondary_predeclared.manual_trophic_groups: used only for interpretation and cross-trophic description, not for the primary test
secondary_predeclared.status: secondary; no secondary result can rescue a failed primary hypothesis
secondary_predeclared.trait_question: Do external species traits explain carrier excess after occupied-node count has already been conditioned out?

site_estimability.non_estimable_action: retain site in fixed denominator, report response-consumed non-estimable stop, do not replace

uncertain_coordinate_policy.action: exclude row prospectively from all spatial metrics; count excluded target-positive rows and distinct X node labels
